correctness.rationale: For every n>=2 and every global-parity-feasible signature, choosing n-1 path-edge directions forces all spoke orientations and the hub parity, yielding exactly 2^(n-1) unrestricted orientations. The fan is chordal, so a directed cycle is present iff a directed apex triangle is present. The triangle criterion gives an exact four-state transfer with a one-to-one path/orientation correspondence. The complete reachable-support automaton (C -> A or U; A -> B or C; B -> A or U; U absorbing) proves the even-n paired-bit obstruction and its precise 2^(n/2-1) count, and proves all odd n feasible. The package-path verify.py independently exhausts 699048 literal edge orientations for n=2..10 and 2044 corresponding feasible signature comparisons; transfer-only n=11..16 tests corroborate the unrestricted combinatorial proof.

originality.rationale: The problem is the established T-odd acyclic-orientation problem. Relevant Gravier et al. results characterize Cartesian products and general source/sink conditions; Cardinal et al. enumerate unrestricted chordal acyclic orientations; Stanley counts unrestricted total acyclic orientations. None of the inspected claims yields the fan parity-fibre counts and explicit even-order paired-bit feasibility obstruction. Queries of matching objects, alias terminology, generic stronger graph families, and mathematical-record neighbours disclosed no covering theorem. The wheel and multi-theta parity-fibre studies concern different edge sets and do not imply a fan formula by specialization. This is a self-review with residual priority risk.
residual_risks: Full article-by-article exhaustive priority review was not performed; a differently named exact fan parity-fibre theorem might exist.
The 2022 chordal generation paper was read in relevant sections rather than line-by-line throughout; general Gray-code enumeration might be adapted to derive the result but does not state it.

Generic bounded-treewidth methods may provide linear-time counting on fans; value and novelty are attached primarily to the complete explicit parity-signature obstruction classification, not merely existence of an algorithm.
The original Stanley 1973 full text was not inspected; only its standard total-count consequence is used.

value.rationale: The acyclic indegree-parity existence problem is a current motivated graph-orientation problem with subtle obstructions beyond the global parity congruence. Fans are the natural chain-of-triangles maximal-outerplanar family with unbounded order and overlapping triangles. The theorem determines every feasible/infeasible parity prescription and its exact acyclic-orientation multiplicity, not an arbitrary small parameter slice. Its sharp exponential forbidden-family census and odd-even realizability dichotomy are structural and are not implied by general parity feasibility or unrestricted chromatic-polynomial counts. The algorithm and exhaustive checks support reproducibility; neither alone supplies value.
